name: web-green-farm-dashboard-on-monitor-cover
title: Green Farm Dashboard on Monitor
whatItIs: A cover with a white desktop monitor showing a farm management dashboard: pasture growth bars, rainfall chart, task lists and a large aerial farm map with paddock cards, all in fresh greens.
whatItMeans: Aerial fields and green charts tie data to the land, making a technical tool feel natural and approachable.
techniques: Aerial imagery as the dominant right-hand panel
Green tint across all charts to match the subject
Clean white monitor on a white background for simplicity
Small overlay cards on the map for key stats
AI prompt bar at the bottom of the map
bestFor: Data products with a geographic element

vocabulary.definition: A satellite or drone view used as a dashboard hero.
A small card floating over a map showing local data.
Colouring UI to match the subject matter.
